Habitat V0.6.1

Changelog

  • Added: Trackpad Edges! Squeak now features a new section in trackpad gestures to drag your finger along the edges of the trackpad to adjust brightness, volume, keyboard backlight, and more.
  • Added: Support for Macbook Proled notch with the notch nook capsule.
  • Improved: Leap dock folder size now matches other icons, and improved the docks reappearing timing when switching between spaces.
  • Improved: Performance of Spark menubar icon dropdown. Stats and animations now use less resources.
  • Fixed: Chomp Junk cleaner trash not listing items.
  • Fixed: Notch nook dismissal animation sometimes breaking or looking broken. Also fixed tool cards animation sometimes breaking when switching between each.
  • Fixed: Startup permissions showing when setting up Habitat for the first time or after an update sometimes.


    • More to come.

    — Thank you for all the support & feedback!
